attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"This is the same road where the Iron Covenant lost a wagon to raiders","severity":"minor","reason":"The briefing places the loss only 'near the gorge', not on the gorge road itself."},{"span":"Making demands of a neighbour twice your size takes real nerve","severity":"minor","reason":"The briefing does not say the toll or any demand was aimed at the Iron Covenant."}],"voice":5,"clarity":5,"tone":5,"overall":4,"comment":"A sharp, consistent bulletin that ties the toll to earlier news and makes good jokes from the faction sizes. It slightly overstates the links, placing the wagon loss on the toll road and aiming the demands at the Covenant."}
